notes.title: New Year's Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Happy New Year and hope you are all safe and well :)
We're still hard at work over here and taking suggestions.
Here is the latest update for Metagroove!

-Drumkit added. Load beat sounds (or any sounds) and have them react to other music!
-Ultra wide screen monitors support
-Animation settings for in game HUD (use U)
-Improved performance for various objects
-Scale smoothing (use T)
-Vortex animation recycling
-Mute audio track for drumkit
-Sequencer fixes
-Various other bug fixes

Thanks for your support!
-Josh

notes.title: Alpha Update v0.3
notes.content:
Big Content Update! Alpha v0.3

So much thanks for trying it and helping us out with your feedback!

What's new:
[list]
[*] Sequencer - Add events to make an entire sequence of visualization, everything customizable
[*] Particle systems - Add various particle systems to your visualization
[*] Object mover - Now you can move any object around with the mouse
[*] Vortex updates - you can customize the size and shape of the vortex
[*] Logo object - a dedicated object for adding your logo, from a transparent image
[*] Multiple animations - now you can select multiple animations for your layouts in some circumstances
[*] Font selector - now you can choose multiple fonts for text
[*] Audio improvements - select multiple audio devices for input and recording
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fix for video recording audio missing
[*] Fix for custom loaded 3d models scaling
[*] Object cycling fixes
[*] Tons of other fixes
[/list]

As always you can visit our Discord for constant updates!
https://discord.gg/wAbpqFDYf9

notes.title: Fairly big bug fix update!
notes.content:
Hey all!
Thanks for your support, comments, question, and ideas. We're
really making a lot of progress! Your help has been invaluable so far.
Our Mac update is a little delayed, but there is a version now up to play with.
It should be updated with the newest stuff tomorrow!

Here is the list of improvements we've added to the update:

[b]New stuff[/b]

Background landscapes added (Sci fi, Rocky Hills, Corridor, Industrial)
Material Editor - Add various material types to objects
New effects (Crosshatch, Painterly, Glitch)
Now Mp3, Wav, Aiff, and Ogg support, super fast loading
Some new models added
Some new characters added
Background Scaling options
Audio input options


[b]Bugfixes[/b]

Randomizer fixed
Hotkeys and help fixed (Help is now H)
Audio fixes in Video recording (Video recording is shift + R) 
Shape cycling fixes (Press 1 to cycle different objects)
Save settings fixes (Press shift + 1, 2, etc to save your settings)

As we continue to do updates and fixes, please join our discord to add
your ideas and comments, we'd love to hear them! This is still a work
in progress so be prepared to find some more bugs. We will get to them :)

Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/NdXKAxkwx6]Metagroove Discord Server[/url]

Thanks again,
Josh
